steps.en: Run the installer on a computer that stays on
steps.zh: 在一台常开的电脑上运行安装脚本

steps.en: Onboard: verify model access, create the workspace, install the Gateway daemon
steps.zh: 走引导：确认模型可用、建工作区、装好 Gateway 后台服务

steps.en: Connect a chat channel and approve who may message it
steps.zh: 接上一个聊天渠道，批准谁可以给它发消息

steps.en: The Gateway receives each message and routes it to a session
steps.zh: Gateway 收到每条消息，分派到对应会话

steps.en: Runs the model with tools and skills, then replies in the same chat
steps.zh: 调用模型和工具、技能把事办了，在同一个聊天里回复

steps.en: Writes notes to Markdown memory files and searches them in later chats
steps.zh: 把要点写进 Markdown 记忆文件，以后聊天时再检索出来

value.en: One assistant, running on your own hardware, answers you inside the chat apps you already use
value.zh: 一个跑在你自己硬件上的助手，在你本来就用的聊天软件里回你

sources: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw#quick-start (openclaw onboard --install-daemon; onboarding verifies model access, creates the workspace, configures the Gateway)
https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw#security (openclaw pairing approve <channel> <code>; tools run on the host unless sandboxing is configured)
